status: unfrozen plan; no outcome table has been read for it; scoring not started

assay_table.terms: article CC BY; repository MIT licence file; whether the MIT text governs the data tables is not spelled out; owner confirmation of this basis is required before the run; no commercial data rights are inferred

construct: Ba/F3 cells expressing the wild-type (exon 14 retained) TPR-MET intracellular domain fusion, IL-3 withdrawal; the exon 14-skipped library (EX_ files) is not used

endpoint.name: gamma
endpoint.definition: ROSACE_effects(inhibitor) - ROSACE_effects(DMSO) for the same variant (the article's gamma = beta_inh - beta_DMSO; log2 fitness scale; wild-type synonymous = 0; each inhibitor dosed at its own IC50, so drugs are modelled separately)
excluded_drugs: capmatinib, glumetinib, cabozantinib, glesatinib analog (no experimental complex)

eligibility.rule: missense variant with numeric effects in both the inhibitor and the DMSO condition and ROSACE.LOF == FALSE in DMSO (the file's own flag); position inside 1059-1345; no outcome-based filtering otherwise

missing_data.policy: exporter masks are final; no imputation. Primary comparison on the common complete-case rows of each drug (L, T and C all available); the same rows and folds for every feature set. The only analysis-side fill: L_min_sidechain_dist_A at glycine sites takes L_min_heavy_dist_A, with an indicator column (documented, training-independent). Missingness (unresolved loops, engineered template residues) is not random: results apply to resolved regions only; coverage by region is reported

uncertainty_handling.posterior_sd: approximate sd_gamma = sqrt(sd_inh^2 + sd_DMSO^2) from the filtered table, independence assumed although controls are shared; used only for a sensitivity restricted to variants with sd_gamma at or below the median, and as context for the MSE scale. It does not establish a smallest detectable improvement.

feature_sets.F0: mutation properties (14 numeric M columns) + drug baseline (per-drug model intercept)
feature_sets.F1: F0 + ligand/site context L (4 columns + glycine indicator)
feature_sets.F3: F1 + TopoFold angular features T (7 kappa, 6 sin tau, 6 cos tau)
feature_sets.F4_optional_external: F1 + ESM-1b log-likelihood ratio taken from the authors' pre-binning feature file (inputs only; their predictions and model outputs excluded); requires one pinned download of that file (about 7 MB) and verification of the column before use

comparisons.meaning: equal-coordinate head-to-head of the two geometry encodings (primary)
angular features beyond a language-model baseline

folds.outer: 10 contiguous blocks of positions (29 or 28 each), identical for all feature sets, drugs and models
folds.buffer: training excludes positions within 8 residues of the held-out block on both sides (windows span 4 residues each side, so windows overlap up to separation 8)
folds.inner: 5 contiguous blocks over the training positions with the same buffer, for ridge alpha only
folds.grouping: all substitutions and all drugs at a position are held out together
folds.limits: blocking is in sequence; residues close in space but distant in sequence stay correlated; shared DMSO control and libraries make drugs correlated, so the six drugs are not six independent replicates

models.ridge: per-drug ridge, features standardized on training rows only, alpha in {0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000} chosen by the inner blocks
models.gbm: per-drug HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=200, min_samples_leaf=20, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=0), no tuning

primary_metric.name: mean squared error of gamma
primary_metric.aggregation: within a drug, squared errors averaged per position then over held-out positions with equal position weight; then equal-weight mean over the six drugs
primary_metric.difference: Delta = MSE(a) - MSE(b); negative favours a
secondary: per-drug Pearson and Spearman correlation (comparable in kind to the correlations the authors report, not on their splits)

decision_rule.consistent_improvement: Delta < 0 AND the 95% percentile interval of a moving-block bootstrap (blocks of 20 consecutive positions, all drugs resampled together, 2000 resamples) excludes 0 AND Delta < 0 in at least 8 of 10 outer blocks AND in at least 5 of 6 drugs
decision_rule.no_improvement: Delta >= 0, or Delta < 0 in at most 5 of 10 outer blocks
decision_rule.claim_requires: the same classification for both ridge and GBM; five pre-specified comparisons, no multiplicity correction claimed; intervals are descriptive (coverage not assumed)
decision_rule.practical_usefulness: separate from the statistical statement: the owner sets a practical threshold on relative MSE reduction before scoring (proposed default 5%); a statistically consistent improvement below it is reported as not practically useful

external_benchmark.authors_model: XGBoost on 14 interpretable features including ESM-1b LLR and structural features computed from Umol-predicted inhibitor-bound mutant complexes; trained with 8192 feature combinations; test = all variants of one type I and one type II inhibitor, 20% of positions and two amino acids
fair_and_cheap: arm F4 (ESM LLR as an input feature) against F1 under our protocol
descriptive side-by-side of per-inhibitor correlations with the published values, labelled as different splits
no recreation of their model or of Umol structures
external_benchmark.not_permitted: any claim of superiority over the authors' model; their strongest competitor uses mutant-complex structure predictions that our wild-type-template features do not have

budget.downloads: none required; optional one file of about 7 MB for arm F4
budget.estimate: per-drug ridge and shallow GBM on a few thousand rows: about 2 CPU-minutes

acceptance_conditions: plan, evaluation code and tests hash-frozen before the first scoring run
all input hashes match this plan; exporter freeze verified
identical row sets and folds across all feature sets (asserted)
buffer and grouping tests pass on synthetic data (no training row within 8 residues of a held-out block; all substitutions and drugs of a position in the same fold)
no outcome-dependent feature or row selection; scaling and tuning inside training folds only (tested with a leakage probe on synthetic data)
results JSON contains every comparison, per-block and per-drug values, coverage and exclusions; report generated from it
stop and report if any gate fails; a negative or inconclusive outcome completes the task
